sentences.text: Mosswood achieves higher test accuracy than Harrier-GCN on Sorrel-Cite (0.837 vs 0.814) and Sorrel-Cite-XL (0.791 vs 0.762), but lower accuracy on Tamarind-Social (0.679 vs 0.683).
Compared with Kittiwake-Net, Mosswood also shows higher accuracy on Sorrel-Cite (0.837 vs 0.809) and Sorrel-Cite-XL (0.791 vs 0.770), yet lower accuracy on Tamarind-Social (0.679 vs 0.690).
No statistical tests were reported, so the significance of these differences is not established.
